design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it used student-level sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any method that accounts for school clustering in the analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and only discusses internal validation strategies.
